name: [YARA YARA] Phonk Clicker 🎶
desc:
🎵 Phonk Clicker 🎵

Welcome to the ultimate Brazilian Phonk clicking experience!

💰 Click to earn money while listening to powerful Funk tracks. Every click increases your earnings and helps you unlock even crazier songs.

🔥 Collect unique Funk tracks
💸 Earn more cash with every upgrade
🎧 Unlock legendary music packs
⚡ Increase your money per click
🏆 Become the richest Funk listener on the server

🛒 Visit the shop and buy new songs to boost your earnings. Each track has its own style, effects, and rewards. Start with basic songs and work your way up to the most expensive and powerful Funk anthems.

🔄 Weekly Updates!
New songs, upgrades, features, and events are added every week. Check back often so you don't miss the newest Funk hits.

⭐ Features:
• Simple and satisfying clicker gameplay
• Huge collection of Funk music
• Powerful upgrades and progression system
• Regular content updates
• Competitive leaderboard
